extracted.intended_audience: general readers, students, and scholars of 17th-century English history and literature (readers of Samuel Pepys' diary)
extracted.subtask_description: An unabridged, annotated transcription of Samuel Pepys's diary (March 1668–1669) presenting daily entries and editorial notes; aimed at readers and researchers interested in primary-source 17th-century social and political history. The page is a literary/historical text rather than a guideline or rubric.
